text: Entry Requirements The applicant must be a foreign citizen in good health, aged between 18 and 35, possessing a valid passport, and has graduated from an institution equal to Chinese senior high school.Applicant used to have a Chinese nationality should hold a valid foreign passport or other nationality certificate issued at least 4 years ago. Moreover, during the last 4 years (up to 30th April in the year of admission), the length of residence in that country should be more than 2 years. HSK Certificate (4th level or above) Applicants without an HSK certificate (4th level or above) should attend the Mandarin level test organized by DMU. Those who get a result equivalent to HSK 4th level or above will be considered.
